stimulus.name: STIMULUS
stimulus.description: The passage or source material the item's parts are about.

paragraphs.name: PARAGRAPHS
paragraphs.description: The stimulus text, one string per paragraph. Addressable as p1, p2, …

scoring.name: SCORING
scoring.description: How an item's parts combine: `additive` sums them (default), `conjunctive` awards the item only if every part is fully correct.

prompt.name: PROMPT
prompt.description: The question stem shown to the candidate.

shuffle.name: SHUFFLE
shuffle.description: Present the list in a random order — a choice's options, a dropdown's options, or an order's elements. Defaults to true; `shuffle false` keeps the authored order.

min-choices.name: MIN_CHOICES
min-choices.description: Fewest options the candidate may select. Defaults to 0.

max-choices.name: MAX_CHOICES
max-choices.description: Most options the candidate may select. Defaults to 1, which is single-select.

granularity.name: GRANULARITY
granularity.description: What a hottext makes clickable: whole `sentence`s, or single `word`s.

within.name: WITHIN
within.description: Select within the item's `stimulus` rather than the hottext's own text. One of `within` or `text` is required.

quote.name: QUOTE
quote.description: The text this selection names, copied from the passage.

upper-bound.name: UPPER_BOUND
upper-bound.description: Most points the mapped selections can earn. Set it below the number of correct answers to ask for any N of them.

response.name: RESPONSE
response.description: One answer a blank recognizes. Its `assess` says what that answer is worth.

base-type.name: BASE_TYPE
base-type.description: What this blank's answers are: `string` (the default) compares text, `float` and `integer` compare numbers.

input-formats.name: INPUT_FORMATS
input-formats.description: Which written forms a numeric blank accepts: `numeric` (any, the default), or a list of `decimal`, `fraction` and `scientific`.

tolerance.name: TOLERANCE
tolerance.description: How far a numeric answer may be from the expected one and still count. Absolute and symmetric.

case-sensitive.name: CASE_SENSITIVE
case-sensitive.description: Whether capitals have to match. Defaults to false, and a response may override the interaction's setting.

exemplar.name: EXEMPLAR
exemplar.description: A response that would earn full marks, shown to the reader alongside the rubric.

descriptor.name: DESCRIPTOR
descriptor.description: What a response has to do to earn this band.

response-processing.name: RESPONSE_PROCESSING
response-processing.description: How the response is scored: `map-response` scores each option and sums them (default), `match-correct` awards the points only for exactly the correct set.

id.name: ID
id.description: Identifier for this option. Derived as A, B, C… when omitted.

assess.name: ASSESS
assess.description: Scoring for this option. Its presence turns scoring on.

correct.name: CORRECT
correct.description: Marks the option as a right answer. Stands alone — it takes no value.

points.name: POINTS
points.description: What this option is worth. Defaults to 1 with `correct`; negative penalizes.

rationale.name: RATIONALE
rationale.description: Why this option is right or wrong. Shown against it once the candidate has selected it.

position.name: POSITION
position.description: `order` only: where this element belongs in the right sequence, counting from 1.

target.name: TARGET
target.description: `match` only: the id of the target this item is matched with.

category.name: CATEGORY
category.description: `classification` only: the id of the category this item belongs in.

token.name: TOKEN
token.description: `gap-match` only: the id of the token that fills this gap.

navigation.name: NAVIGATION
navigation.description: QTI's navigationMode. `linear` means the candidate cannot return to an item they have left; `nonlinear` (the default) lets them move freely.

submission.name: SUBMISSION
submission.description: QTI's submissionMode. `individual` submits each item as it is answered; `simultaneous` (the default) holds everything until the end.

items.name: ITEMS
items.description: An activity: the items a candidate works through, in order, then the activity's configuration.

item.name: ITEM
item.description: An item: an optional stimulus and one or more interactions scored together.

parts.name: PARTS
parts.description: The interactions an item is made of, in the order they are presented.

choice.name: CHOICE
choice.description: A choice interaction: a stem and a list of options to select from.

options.name: OPTIONS
options.description: The options a choice interaction offers, each an attribute list.

hottext.name: HOTTEXT
hottext.description: A hottext interaction: a passage with clickable sentences or words.

selections.name: SELECTIONS
selections.description: The places a hottext interaction can select, each named by a quote.

text-entry.name: TEXT_ENTRY
text-entry.description: A text-entry interaction: a sentence with blanks the candidate types into.

blanks.name: BLANKS
blanks.description: The blanks in a text-entry's sentence, each named by the marker that positions it.

responses.name: RESPONSES
responses.description: The answers a blank recognizes, each with what it is worth.

inline-choice.name: INLINE_CHOICE
inline-choice.description: An inline-choice interaction: a sentence with dropdowns the candidate picks from.

dropdowns.name: DROPDOWNS
dropdowns.description: The dropdowns in an inline-choice's sentence, each named by the marker that positions it.

order.name: ORDER
order.description: An order interaction: elements the candidate puts into the right sequence.

elements.name: ELEMENTS
elements.description: The things an order interaction sequences, in the order they are presented.

match.name: MATCH
match.description: A match interaction: each item is paired with one of the targets.

targets.name: TARGETS
targets.description: The things a match's items are paired with, each named by an id.

match-items.name: MATCH_ITEMS
match-items.description: The things a match pairs off, each saying which target it belongs with.

classification.name: CLASSIFICATION
classification.description: A classification interaction: each item is sorted into one of the categories.

categories.name: CATEGORIES
categories.description: The categories a classification sorts into, each named by an id.

classification-items.name: CLASSIFICATION_ITEMS
classification-items.description: The things a classification sorts, each saying which category it belongs in.

gap-match.name: GAP_MATCH
gap-match.description: A gap-match interaction: a sentence whose gaps are filled from a shared bank of tokens.

tokens.name: TOKENS
tokens.description: The bank a gap-match's gaps are filled from, each token named by an id.

gaps.name: GAPS
gaps.description: The gaps in a gap-match's sentence, each named by the marker that positions it.

extended-text.name: EXTENDED_TEXT
extended-text.description: An extended-text interaction: a written response, scored by a person against a rubric.

rubric.name: RUBRIC
rubric.description: The bands a written response is scored against, each an attribute list.
